limitations: Synthetic generator is a teaching mechanism, not evidence about containers.
Small outer sample cannot establish general model superiority.
Intercept-only quadrature checks a subproblem, not the whole regression posterior.
Proportional odds remains a scientific restriction even when sampler diagnostics pass.
